thread:
maria_acct_exec: Heads-up — prospect (AtlasHealth) wants SOC2 Type II, ISO cert, and a short pen-test attestation for the pilot. Need by next Tue. Also asked: will sharing these docs require a custom contract or change to POC pricing? tagging @josh_se @lina_compliance @tom_legal

josh_se: Good question. The POC is hosted on our sandbox hosted tier. Sharing redacted artifacts shouldn't change pricing. If they request on-prem or a dedicated env then that could. We'll confirm isolation notes.

lina_compliance: We can provide a redacted SOC2 report, ISO27001 certificate, and a signed pen-test attestation (high level only). We do not provide raw vuln scans or full pen-test findings without a signed NDA and internal request form. ETA to prepare an "evidence packet": 48-72 hours.

tom_legal: Confirmed. Standard NDA + one-way use clause acceptable. If they want the full test report we need a legal request + exec sign-off. I'll prepare the NDA template and a short permitted-use paragraph.

maria_acct_exec: They also asked whether the SOC2 certificate can be stamped "for vendor evaluation only" in the cover note. Is that OK?

josh_se: Yes that's fine. We'll add a one-line cover stating limited use and confidentiality. I'll also add the POC dataflow diagram (sanitized) so they can see ingress/egress.

lina_compliance: Plan: assemble files and upload to secure bucket, then share link after NDA signed (unless customer explicitly ok with redacted copies over email). Files we will include: "SOC2-Redacted-2024.pdf", "ISO27001-Cert.pdf", "PenTest-Attestation-Lina-signed.pdf", "POC-Dataflow-Sanitized.pdf", "Evidence-Cover-Note.pdf".

compliance_bot: Upload queued: gs://redwood-evidence/requests/1772239999/ (access pending). Please confirm when NDA is in place.

maria_acct_exec: Customer said they will review NDA tonight. Quick follow-up: prospect's procurement requires an explicit statement of "no change to quoted POC fees for evidence sharing" — can someone provide one-liner we can paste in procurement form?

josh_se: One-liner: "Redwood Inference confirms that providing redacted compliance artifacts for vendor evaluation does not alter the quoted POC fees. Any infrastructure or managed-support changes requested by the customer may incur additional charges as separately quoted."

tom_legal: Approved. I'd shorten for procurement: "Sharing redacted compliance artifacts will not change POC fees." We can attach the longer clause if they push.

lina_compliance: Once NDA is signed I'll upload the pack and mark it shared. If they sign NDA we can also include the pen-test attestation PDF.

compliance_bot: Upload completed: gs://redwood-evidence/requests/1772239999/ Files: SOC2-Redacted-2024.pdf, ISO27001-Cert.pdf, PenTest-Attestation-Lina-signed.pdf, POC-Dataflow-Sanitized.pdf, Evidence-Cover-Note.pdf. Access: sales, se, compliance, legal.

maria_acct_exec: Shared with AtlasHealth procurement. They confirmed receipt and said it satisfies their checklist. Closing out — thanks all. :tada:
